title: The Solar Electric Van Project · Soleva Website
h2: Soleva converts an old van to the most sustainable camper: fully powered by the sun #
The freedom and comfort of travelling with minimal environmental footprint.
Promote sustainable travelling and renewable energies #
Get involved and become part of the unique project #
Pave the way for a faster and affordable transition. Reuse what we already have to build the fair car of tomorrow. #
paragraphs: Soleva converts an old van to the most sustainable camper: fully powered by the sun # An old van at the end of the road gets retrofitted to an electric vehicle with an innovative deployable solar roof, a belly full of batteries and a cosy, eco-friendly and self-sufficient interior habitat . A Swiss demonstration project by young and passionate engineers to promote and inspire a faster transition to renewable energy and CO2 free travel.
The freedom and comfort of travelling with minimal environmental footprint.
A van fully powered by the free, renewable energy of the sun, produced using solar panels carried on board
Instead of a new product, we upcycle and retrofit an existing car to a second, green life
Fully self-sufficient. Move around anywhere with zero CO2 emissions and help decarbonizing mobility
Drive up to 30'000km per year for free without external charging and cheaper than a new electric car.
An off-grid, renewably powered but comfortable living space built with reused and recycled materials.
Discover our documentary or the news and interviews of the Soleva project in various newspapers, radios and on TV showcasing our solar electric camper.
This journey needs your support to become a reality. Help us on our mission to bring as many people as possible into the mobility and energy transition.
You are young and passionate about solutions to climate change. You believe you have valuable skills for the Soleva team?
You want to promote your sustainable technology on a habitation solution or on electric mobility? You want to integrate it into Soleva? Then join our team of trusted partners.

Despite the fire that ravaged our workshop and swept away Sunny, our first solar van, the Soleva adventure is not over. This event is a blow, but it reinforces our determination to promote sustainable mobility. Sunny's safety systems worked perfectly, proving the reliability of our design. Having inspired so many people with our tour of Switzerland, we refuse to let this dream die. A new solar van is already in the pipeline, driven by our passion and your invaluable support. Thank you for supporting us - the story goes on!
After having lost the first prototype, we now need your help to reach this dream again and being able to build the second version.
